title: Understand PWM/PSSM scores before reading promoter traces

catalog.notes: Score-interpretation guide for PWM/PSSM matrices, PFM counts, motif logos, JASPAR match scores, pseudocounts, log odds, raw LLR bits, relative scores, quantiles and inclusive background tails. Distinguishes sequence preference from binding affinity, occupancy and reporter activity; explains the corrected TP73 MA0861.2 tail score and shared-scale traces. Hands-on native TSS inspection is deliberately split into tutorial 08.16; TSS collection derivation remains 08.15.
